whyItMatters: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: q}} /> binds unescaped markup in javascript, so untrusted input in the value becomes script execution.
actions: Replace the raw binding with text children or DOMPurify.sanitize.
If raw markup is required, sanitize the value against an allowlist first.
Re-run the scan and confirm no raw binding remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no raw binding reachable from untrusted input, and markup probes render inert.
